posts.text: [Image] The White House is shown from the lawn, with the American flag flying above it and leafless trees and trimmed shrubs in the foreground. Three black garbage bags sit on the grass, labeled with the logos of CNN, MSNBC, and Politico, creating a pointed visual statement about those news organizations.

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 20, 2026
posts.text: [Image] A political graphic titled “U.S. Poverty Rate At Record Low” shows a line chart labeled “Official Poverty Rate, All People, 1959–2025.” The black line tracks rates from roughly 22% in the 1960s to about 8% near 2025. Red text attributes a claimed 10.2% record low to Donald Trump, with a large downward arrow.

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 20, 2026
posts.text: [Image] A bar chart titled “Cumulative Change in Price Biden VS Trump 2.0” compares January–July of the second year in office. Blue bars for Joe Biden and red bars for Donald Trump show overall inflation at 12.3% versus 4.3%, groceries at 15.8% versus 3.3%, gasoline at 69% versus 12%, rent at 7.7% versus 4.5%, electricity at 19.1% versus 6.6%, and new and used cars at 23.9% versus −1.2%.

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 20, 2026
posts.text: [Image] A graphic titled “U.S. Household Income at RECORD HIGH” shows a line chart of median U.S. household income from 1967 to 2025, measured in U.S. dollars. The line rises from about $51,000 in 1980 to nearly $90,000 in 2025, with fluctuations along the way. A red upward arrow highlights “TRUMP $87,500.”

posts.title: [No Title] - Post from September 20, 2026
posts.text: [Image] A graphic titled “His Hemisphere” shows a black-and-white close-up of Donald Trump behind a large globe. The globe prominently displays the Arctic region, including Greenland, Canada, the North Atlantic, and surrounding geographic labels. Pink and red concentric shapes form the background behind the image.
